questions.prompt: Which of these TV shows are set in a hospital?
questions.fact: ER ran for fifteen seasons and made a star of George Clooney.

questions.prompt: Which of these were civilisations of ancient Mesopotamia?
questions.fact: Sumer gave the world some of its earliest writing, pressed into wet clay with a reed.

questions.prompt: How many years did it take to build the Sydney Opera House?
questions.fact: Fourteen, from 1959 to 1973: ten years late and around fourteen times over budget.

questions.prompt: How far is it from Sydney to Melbourne by road, in kilometres?
questions.fact: The Hume Highway covers about 880 km, and the flight between the two is one of the busiest in the world.

questions.prompt: Which film is set on the moon Pandora?
questions.hint: Its people are tall and blue.
questions.fact: James Cameron waited more than ten years for film technology to catch up with his idea for Avatar.

questions.prompt: Which country has the longest coastline?
questions.hint: Thousands of Arctic islands add to its total.
questions.fact: Canada's coast is about 243,000 km long, enough to go round the Earth six times.
